products.title: Nexus Firefight - Nexus
products.description:
NEXUS FIREFIGHT - A teardrop-shaped carbon power racket. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL 

The NEXUS FIREFIGHT is a racket with which your game can shine due to its great power. With a great ball feel, this racket is perfect for all types of intermediate level players, being able to adapt to the conditions of the match at all times.

PLAYER TYPE 

Racquet specially designed for players looking to handle the blow without losing power in each of their blows. Intermediate level.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE 

This racket is characterized by its 3K carbon that provides durability and resistance. Its teardrop/diamond shape helps you have extra power with a more controlled game in the defensive phases of the game. 

Its smooth gloss finish makes its color stand out. Aesthetically it has a modern and striking design. Features a combination of glossy black with neon yellow and white details

PLAY STYLE

The NEXUS FIREFIGHT is designed for a balanced playstyle, albeit with a bias towards power.

products.title: Siux Invicta - Siux
products.description:
SIUX INVICTA - The ideal racket to increase the power of your blows. Its characteristic diamond bridge makes our aerial game look improved. 

INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The SIUX INVICTA is one of those padel rackets that makes you eye-catching with its design. A diamond format racket, where it is clearly intended for a game based on power, with a high balance and a sweet spot more towards the tip of it.

PLAYER TYPE

It is a racket recommended for those looking for a power game, advanced level players who want to finish the point quickly.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The SIUX INVICTA is a powerful racket, very powerful, ideal for standing out with a more offensive game than with a control racket. This diamond format places the weight at the top of the racket, which favors shots, vipers and layups.

It has a carbon fiber tubular, and 3K carbon flats. They are high-performance materials that offer power, durability and consistency in your game.

Inside it incorporates medium density EVA rubber, which offers a balanced touch. This core allows us to feel the ball well when hitting, to also help us have good touch to achieve good defense.

As a novelty in its design, it has a beautiful bridge, which in addition to enhancing aesthetics, improves balance.
